digest.component_or_area: operational script for repository history rewriting
propositions: Build a committed one-time history-strip script using stock Git plumbing (fast-export/fast-import) that removes .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes from all historical revisions while preserving DAG topology, merge commits, and empty commits.

Prove the rewritten branch in a fresh unfiltered --no-tags scratch clone matches old-tip commit and merge-commit counts, produces byte-identical tree after dynamic re-add, contains no .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ history, and measures ≤150 MiB packed size.

The script must refuse execution on blob:none partial clones, dynamically derive the re-add set from git ls-tree of old-tip, parse fast-export data blocks by exact byte length (not line-based grep), and leave source remote branch and protected tag unchanged with no local push.
An adversarial commit message beginning with 'M ' must survive byte-identically through the binary fast-export stream filter, proving correct framing of file commands versus message data.
